recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-key studio portrait of a couple in contrasting attire, framed by a thin black border. The composition features a woman in a white bridal gown wearing athletic sneakers, seated in front of a man in casual grey knitwear, with bold, multi-colored sans-serif typography stacked at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between formal bridal attire and casual athletic footwear
Tight physical proximity between subjects suggesting a romantic dynamic
Typographic weight hierarchy mirroring the visual importance of the subjects
Clean white negative space focusing attention on the central figures
coreInvariants: Primary color palette of red, black, and white
Stacked typographic header with varying weights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame in a mid-shot portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's white bridal gown and the bright white sneakers create high-contrast focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold red and black header, move down to the subjects' faces, and follow the diagonal line of the leg to the sneakers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space at the top and sides creates a clean, commercial look.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background and bridal gown) providing a clean, bright base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (typography and frame) for legibility and structure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red (typography) to draw immediate attention to key names.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value and low saturation in the background, with high saturation in the red text elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, black, white, and natural skin/clothing tones.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke thickness for the boldest weights
Tight letter spacing (kerning) to create a solid block effect
Vertical stacking of text lines with minimal leading
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard font weights for hierarchy.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast within the same or similar sans-serif families.

preserve: Red/Black color split in the header

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the thick, impactful weight of the primary title.
Provides the clean geometric look for the secondary weights.
Standard high-legibility sans-serif for commercial layouts.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photograph of a man in a grey sweater and a woman in a white bridal gown sitting together against a pure white background. The woman should be wearing white athletic sneakers. Frame the entire image with a thin black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of uppercase sans-serif text at the top. The first line should alternate between red and black weights. The second line should be a large, bold black word followed by a lighter weight black word. Add a final line of small, widely-spaced red text at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Are the sneakers clearly visible against the bridal gown?
Is the typography strictly uppercase sans-serif?
Is the thin black border present around the entire composition?

adjustableVariables: Color of the accent text (red can be swapped for other bright colors)
postGenerationChecks: Verify the red text is vibrant and legible
Ensure the subjects do not overlap the top text block
Check that the bottom text is perfectly centered
Confirm the black border is uniform on all sides
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Stacked Sans-Serif Header (Red/Black) + High-Key White Background + Thin Black Frame.
